title: Question 6.1: Accuracy Calculation - Evaluator Setup
instruction: This code sets up a tool that will compare predictions to actual answers.
reveal: This creates an evaluator object that knows which columns contain the actual answers ("label") and which contain the model's predictions ("prediction"). The evaluator will use these columns to calculate various metrics that tell us how well the model performed.
